questions.event_title: 2026 Taipei Mayoral Election: Margin of Victory
questions.question: Will Puma Shen win the 2026 Taipei Mayoral Election by 8% or more?
questions.rules:
The 2026 Taipei mayoral election is scheduled to take place on November 28, 2026, to elect the next mayor of Taipei.

This market will resolve according to the margin of victory between the top two candidates in the specified election.

For the purpose of this market, the “margin of victory” is defined as the absolute difference between the percentages of valid votes received by the first-place and second-place candidates. Percentages of the valid votes received by each candidate will be determined by dividing the total number of valid votes each of the top two candidates receives by the sum of all valid votes cast in the election.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher margin bracket.

If two or more candidates tie for the most valid votes in this election, and the tie is between two candidates listed, this market will resolve to the lowest margin bracket for the candidate whose listed last name comes first in alphabetical order. If the tie is between a listed candidate and an unlisted candidate, this market will resolve to the lowest margin bracket for the listed candidate. If the tie is between two or more unlisted candidates, this market will resolve to “Other.”

This market will resolve based on the official vote count once the count has been made official.

If the election results are not known definitively by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Taiwanese government, specifically the Central Election Commission (https://db.cec.gov.tw/).

If a recount is initiated before the vote total has been made official, the market will remain open until the recount is completed and the vote is made official.

questions.news_query: Puma Shen win Taipei Mayoral Election

forecast.reasoning: Incumbent KMT mayor Chiang Wan-an won Taipei comfortably in 2022, and the city leans blue. Mid-November polls were split, with Shen ahead in two and Chiang ahead in two. That suggests a competitive race, but a big Shen win would be needed here. Shen winning by 8 points or more would require a large polling miss against the historical pattern, so this is unlikely.

questions.bet_note: Gap vs. the price we'd pay is 8.2 points; counting only part of it (cautious sizing) leaves 4.0, under the 10-point minimum.

questions.question: Will Pabel Muñoz win the next Quito mayoral election?
questions.rules:
The 2026 Quito, Ecuador mayoral election is currently scheduled to be held on November 29, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who becomes the next Mayor of Quito as a result of this election.

Temporary, interim, or placeholder mayors appointed before the election will not be considered.

If the result of this election isn't known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting; however, if there is any ambiguity in the results, this market will resolve according to official information from the Ecuadorian government, including the National Electoral Council (Consejo Nacional Electoral, CNE, https://www.cne.gob.ec) and the Contentious Electoral Tribunal (Tribunal Contencioso Electoral, TCE, https://www.tce.gob.ec).
questions.news_query: Pabel Muñoz win Quito mayoral election | Quito Mayoral Election Winner Pabel Muñoz

forecast.reasoning: Incumbent Pabel Muñoz won in 2023 with only about a quarter of the vote. His administration has faced weak approval and recall pressure. The national Correísta movement has also struggled against Noboa's ADN, though Noboa's own popularity dipped after the 2025 referendum loss. A fragmented, single-round plurality race gives an incumbent some chance, but I don't see him as the favorite. I found no recent news either way.
